notes: G is derived from ALL admitted C4 mitigation rows; outcome_label is the only supervision signal. Severity strings high/low are NEVER admitted into G.

J_verified_patch is empty because no wave1 row carries an executed two-revision L6 artefact (violation reproduced on vulnerable SHA + blocked on fixed SHA). J stays empty until real execution is performed; unexecuted patch diffs belong in G.

prove_candidates rows=18: a NOT_SCORABLE pool with no answer and no label fields. A row qualifies only if BOTH vulnerable_commit and fixed_commit are 40-hex SHAs, they are STRICTLY DIFFERENT, and the row has a real permalink/source ref.

dropped_equal_sha=73: admitted rows whose vulnerable_commit equals fixed_commit. They are excluded from prove_candidates but remain unchanged in 04_admitted/c4_mitigation/findings.jsonl as single-SHA records.
dropped_invalid_sha=440, dropped_no_provenance=0: rows failing the 40-hex SHA check or carrying no real permalink/source ref. These three drop counts plus the kept rows partition the admitted rows.

Idempotent derivation: prove_candidates is rewritten from admitted data on every run (deduplicated by candidate_id); this module writes no candidate/admitted/invariants/PRESENT files and makes no network calls.
